page.layout: One printed page (right) with the title page. The left strip shows the cut-off edge of the neighbouring page, which is not transcribed. Title lines run top to bottom, then the Greek motto, then the emblem, then the imprint.

main_text.l: ἡ μὲν ἐμπειρία τέχνην ἐποίησεν, ἡ δὲ ἀπειρία τύχην.

page.notes: Engraving between the Greek motto and the imprint: an oval seal with the legend "HINC · LVCEM · ET · POCVLA · SACRA" around its rim, a figure at centre holding a cup, and a central tablet reading "Alma Mater". The left strip is the cut edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed. The Greek motto is transcribed from the scan; some accents and letters in the smaller Greek type are uncertain.
